description: PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for open Government of Canada procurement opportunities — "federal tenders for IT services", "CanadaBuys RFPs for construction in Ontario", "who is the government buying software from". Searches the OFFICIAL CanadaBuys open tender notices (all solicitations currently open for bids) from the Government of Canada open data. Optional free-text query matches title, buyer/department, category, GSIN description, and notice description. Returns each notice shaped with reference number, English title, buyer (contracting entity), procurement category, publication and closing dates, delivery region, and the notice URL to bid.

query.description: Optional free-text search (case-insensitive). Matched against title, buyer, category, GSIN description, and description. Omit to list the most recently published open tenders.

name: canada_search_tenders
title: Canada Search Tenders
